description: Verify that DUT implements Nagle: a small SEND (ssz) is buffered while unacked data is outstanding, but releases as part of the next MSS-filling segment (RFC 1122 §4.2.3.4)
approach:
[Objective]
Variant of NAGLE_02: instead of waiting for ACK, the small write is held until enough data accumulates to fill an MSS-sized segment — then released as one larger segment.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. DUT (UT) small write #1 → DUT → Tester: data #1.
3. DUT (UT) small write of size ssz (Nagle holds it).
4. DUT (UT) sends enough additional data to fill MSS.
5. Observation: DUT → Tester: aggregate segment containing the small ssz + filler.

[Pass condition]
DUT releases the held small write only inside the aggregate MSS segment.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_first_data — first segment missing
• Fail_dut_released_small_segment_before_aggregate — Nagle violation
• Fail_no_aggregate — aggregate segment never appeared

verdicts.Pass: DUT held small write and released as MSS aggregate — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_released_small_segment_before_a: DUT released small segment before aggregate (Nagle violation)
verdicts.Fail_no_aggregate: No DUT aggregate segment after MSS fill
